sloka: न नूनम् तपसो वा अस्ति फल योगः श्रुतस्य वा ।पिता यन् माम् न जानाति शयानम् पतितम् भुवि ॥२-६३-४४॥
transliteration: na nūnam tapaso vā asti phala yogaḥ śrutasya vā ।pitā yan mām na jānāti śayānam patitam bhuvi ॥2-63-44॥

translations.english: 'My father does not know that I am lying on the ground. It is true that there is no reward either for asceticism or for scriptural knowledge.
